periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique diagonal orientation with the primary axis of both patches tilted inward toward the nasal bridge at approximately a 45-degree angle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval morphology with a vertically elongated aspect ratio.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Distinct downward tapering observed, with the lowest point of the patch terminating in a narrow vertex near the rostrum.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: The posterior edge of the transverse band exhibits a broad, shallow U-shaped curvature across the upper back.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High relative thickness, covering approximately 40% of the visible torso length from the shoulder to the mid-back.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation across the cranial crown, with a gap roughly equivalent to 2.5 times the horizontal width of a single ear region.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Uniformly convex and smoothly rounded apical curvature.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant vertical elevation and high-density texture of the white fur along the sagittal midline of the cranium.
